svg.title: Direct distillation sequence: A | BCD, B | CD, C | D
svg.desc: Orthographic process flow diagram of a direct distillation sequence for a four-component mixture A, B, C, D (A lightest). Feed ABCD enters C-101, which takes A overhead and leaves BCD; C-102 takes B overhead and leaves CD; C-103 splits C from D. Each sieve-tray column is drawn in section with its total condenser (two-pass, cooling water on the tubes), reflux drum, inline reflux pump and kettle reboiler (steam in the U-bundle). Columns stand on a common base and narrow down the sequence as the feed shrinks (diameter ∝ √feed: 1, 0.75, 0.5); tray counts follow assumed relative volatilities α_AB 2.0, α_BC 3.0, α_CD 3.6 (Fenske, 99 % key recovery), feed trays follow Kirkbride: C-101 11 trays, feed above tray 6; C-102 7 trays, feed above tray 4; C-103 6 trays, feed above tray 4. Pressure falls from C-101 to C-103, so each bottoms product flows to the next column's feed tray by pressure difference, without a pump.
